title: InclusiveShift-HAR: An Auditable Participant-Exclusive Benchmark for Ability-Associated Population Shift in Smartphone Activity Recognition
description: Research software for auditable, participant-exclusive released-block evaluation of ability-associated population shift in smartphone inertial human activity recognition. The released cohort label is not a direct measure of physical ability, and InclusiveHAR v4 omits timestamps and trial identifiers. In the locked ten-participant target evaluation, compact DANN and CORAL were effectively tied; the full MoRe-HAR configuration scored lower on mean and lower-tail participant macro-F1.
